blog.title: Daily life of an open-source advocate
blog.text: When I grew up as a child, I always wondered how these people managed to fucking run these fancy neovim setups and all these flashing windows moving around on their screen. I had this desire to find out what they were doing, ever since I was in the womb. Once I realised how much data every company is harvesting from you—I pivoted, and never came back—it's been the most wonderful journey I have experienced.

Ever since I was a child, I've been starting to love using Neovim more. I've realised how the corporate monopolies (Microsoft, Visual Studio Code) have actually been trying to HINDER our abilities to create things! YouTube—from Google has also been doing this, same with TikTok and all that typeof() stuff. Crazy, isn't it?? Here's a quote from when I was a child:
blog.quote: When I use Neovim—I will fucking surpass humanity, soar to the skies, climb to the top of the corporate ladder (i will even break the corporate ladder) to make more profit all because I have learned how to surpass humanity with the ultimate skill of editing text, blazingly fast. I will shift mountains, shift seas, and shift humanity towards a better future by editing their genome sequences and making everything software-based so it's more reliable than ever.
